title: Japan Trench · hypocentre sections and the b-value (Draft)
description: The same plan as Drafts only: a start Card and three Drafts that state what each step takes and gives, ready for the Agent's "Generate Cards".

cards.summary: Fetches as CSV, from USGS's FDSN event service, the hypocentres (latitude, longitude, depth, magnitude) of M4 and above around Tohoku and the Japan Trench (34–42°N, 138–146°E) for 2000–2024, and passes them on as a folder.

cards.summary: Cuts out the hypocentres in a band of latitude (lat_min to lat_max, parameters) and shows, in one image, a map of the epicentres and a longitude–depth section (the subducting Pacific plate). Passes the hypocentres cut out on.

cards.summary: Shows the cumulative frequency log10 N(≥M) by magnitude as a line chart, finds the b-value of the Gutenberg–Richter law by maximum likelihood (Aki–Utsu) above the magnitude of completeness mc, and shows it with the fitted line.

notes.html:
The Gutenberg–Richter law

The number NN of earthquakes of magnitude MM or more follows

log⁡10N(≥M)=a−bM\log_{10} N(\ge M) = a - bM

with bb about 1. The maximum-likelihood estimate (Aki 1965, Utsu 1966) is

b=log⁡10eMˉ−(Mc−ΔM/2)b = \frac{\log_{10} e}{\bar M - (M_c - \Delta M/2)}

Change the band of latitude of section or McM_c of b_value and rerun just that Card.

intro: A Draft is a Card that says in words what it receives, what it does and what it passes on. It has no code yet. With "Generate Cards" in the app, the Agent writes code from these words, runs it and checks.
